issues.title: Jordan sentences man to death over attack that killed officer
issues.title_en: Jordan sentences man to death over attack that killed officer
issues.summary: Nov 25 (Reuters) - Jordan's State Security Court on Wednesday sentenced a man to death over an attack that killed a security officer in the capital Amman earlier this month, the armed forces said in a statement.The officer was stabbed near the Sri Lankan embassy on November 5, less ​than two weeks after gunmen opened fire at a church in the southern Karak governorate, both rare assaults in the relatively stable US ally.The court convicted the man of carrying out terrorist acts resulting in death, and of possession of a weapon for terrorist purposes, the statement read.
